name: Simon Jentzsch
description: Simon Jentzsch has worked on Ethereum since 2015, focused on verification and trust-minimized access. He authored EIP-1186 (eth_getProof) — the account and storage proof widely used by light clients. Formerly co-founder and CTO of Slock.it and lead contributor to the Incubed light client, he is now co-founder and CTO of corpus.core and main contributor to colibri-stateless, a stateless Ethereum verifier.
